source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; exact options 00-05 are materially distinct destructive actions.

source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds and behavior matches option.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, one option per fresh approval.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves functional action; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Execute and validate each selected chassis-control semantic independently, without conflating power, reset, NMI and ACPI outcomes.
original_method: Protected 0x00/0x02 with one allowlisted option per approval, option-specific observer and independent recovery.
manual_activity: Owner selects exactly one option and confirms workload impact/recovery immediately before action.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient because power-on cannot cover all options.

modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One option proves only that option.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Can interrupt workload or strand SUT.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tool requires equivalent exact chassis action and observation.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source groups six effects, clears logs and lacks per-option recovery; DeepSeek covers only power-on.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Options are explicit; approvals and environment are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates six checkpoints and forbids substitution/retry.
